$comment: Phase 10 (0.0.27) Task 0 public API freeze manifest. Machine-checkable source of truth consumed by Tasks 1-8 tests: every implementation export name, error code, event type, capability matrix cell, and cap must match this file exactly. Amendment requires a recorded Task 0 freeze amendment in plans/010.

sdk.name: @agentclientprotocol/sdk
sdk.notes: Stable v1 only. Experimental v2 / UNSTABLE fields excluded (see exclusions).

placement.decision: No new publishable package. Extend @arnilo/prism-ag-ui/acp subpath for all protocol adapter surface; add a lifecycle events module to @arnilo/prism-coding-agent for the shared typed events. 47 publishable manifests at freeze; package count must stay 47 through the release gate.

agentInfo.name: Prism
agentInfo.versionSource: @arnilo/prism-ag-ui package.json version via JSON import attribute (import pkg from "../package.json" with { type: "json" }); packages/ag-ui/tsconfig.json gains resolveJsonModule. Replaces stale hard-coded "0.0.12".

dependencyAdditions: @arnilo/prism-coding-agent (0.0.26, workspace) — terminal chunk caps reuse Phase 9 process.outputChunkBytes constants; also serves Task 7 lifecycle mapping

lifecycle.notes: process_started/process_exited/process_killed reuse the shipped CodingProcessEvent union (no new shape). Deferred events have no consumer in 0.0.27: ACP SDK 1.3.0 exposes no update kind for checks, tasks, compaction, or subagents, and no other host requested them. Deferred kinds MUST NOT be exported.

capabilityMatrix.$comment: Advertise iff host wiring provides the seam; absent seam -> key omitted from initialize (never an empty stub that implies support). Client-side capabilities are read from the initialize request and gate later client method use.

mcpCapabilities.http.advertiseWhen: mcp.select seam supplied and bridge supports http transport

mcpCapabilities.sse.advertiseWhen: mcp.select seam supplied and bridge supports sse transport

clientCapabilities.fs.readTextFile: agent may call fs/read_text_file only when true
clientCapabilities.fs.writeTextFile: agent may call fs/write_text_file only when true
clientCapabilities.terminal: agent may call terminal/* only when true
clientCapabilities.session.configOptions.boolean: agent returns configOptions and accepts session/set_config_option only when present
clientCapabilities.elicitation: agent maps elicitation pending decisions to elicitation/create only when present (UNSTABLE on the wire; checked at initialize, never advertised agent-side)

capabilityMatrix.alwaysBaseline: session/new, session/prompt, session/cancel, session/update, session/close (ACP baseline + close). Prompt text + resource_link content blocks always accepted; other prompt content types only under promptCapabilities.

lifecycleEventMapping.$comment: Consumer-gated: only events with a consumer in 0.0.27 ship. Consumers = ACP event mapper + optional host CodingLifecycleEmitter callback. All mappings redacted, ownership-scoped, byte/count capped.
lifecycleEventMapping.process_started: tool_call_update (kind execute) when toolCallId present; else projection-gated agent_message_chunk
lifecycleEventMapping.process_exited: tool_call_update (status completed/failed) when toolCallId present; else projection-gated agent_message_chunk
lifecycleEventMapping.process_killed: tool_call_update (status failed) when toolCallId present; else projection-gated agent_message_chunk
lifecycleEventMapping.file_changed: tool_call_update with locations:[{path}] when toolCallId present (no toolCallId -> dropped); diff content block only when projection supplies a safe diff, capped by acp.diffBytes
lifecycleEventMapping.permission_denied: tool_call_update (status failed); never includes raw tool args
lifecycleEventMapping.configuration_changed: session/update config_option_update carrying the full bounded option set (ConfigOptionUpdate verified in SDK 1.3.0); Task 7 verifies wire gating and falls back to agent_message_chunk if the SDK rejects the update kind for a client
lifecycleEventMapping.deferred: check_started, check_finished, task_created, task_completed, compaction_started, compaction_finished, subagent_started, subagent_stopped -> no ACP update kind, no consumer; not shipped

permissionMatrix.$comment: Phase 8 shared approval contract is NOT widened. ACP options map onto the existing four outcomes; unrecognized option ids and cancelled requests deny-closed.
permissionMatrix.stickyBehavior: unchanged from Phase 8 StickyDecision (allow_for_run/reject_for_run persist for the run only)
permissionMatrix.elicitation: pending decisions with kind "elicitation" map to elicitation/create + elicitation/complete only when clientCapabilities.elicitation present; otherwise stay on the shared interruption path used by AG-UI

caps.$comment: default/hard pairs. Existing AG-UI limits and Phase 9 process caps are reused where they already cover the surface (no duplicate knobs).

sessions.notes: Fixes today's unbounded in-memory ACP session registry (Map with no cap).

promptMediaParts.notes: Reuses AgUiLimitOptions maxInputMediaParts; media bytes reuse maxInputMediaBytes 65536/1048576.

reusedLimits.terminalChunkBytes: 51200/1048576 (Phase 9 process.outputChunkBytes; ACP terminal output forwards ProcessSession chunks, no new knob)

p95Targets.$comment: Local, network-free, recorded by scripts/benchmark-0.0.27.mjs into scripts/budgets.json phase10 section (Task 8). Machine-dependent ceilings.

securityInvariants.clientInputs: All client-provided paths, cwd, additionalDirectories, MCP servers, config options, and prompt content blocks are untrusted and policy-checked through existing execution policy, ownership, sandbox/workspace mode, and approval before any effect.
securityInvariants.capabilityNegotiation: Capability advertisement is a pure function of wired seams; it can never activate a tool, path, or server that the host did not supply.
securityInvariants.modes: Modes only narrow tool availability, write policy, approval policy, prompt contributions, and language/forge capability, or widen with explicit host authorization; they never change tenant/identity and never bypass the policy evaluator. Unknown mode ids fail closed.
securityInvariants.secrets: Credentials never appear in ACP payloads or logs; redaction runs before mapping; permission-denial events never include raw tool args.
securityInvariants.mcp: Experimental acp MCP transport rejected even if a client sends it; stdio/http/sse configs require host select/authorize before bridge connect.
securityInvariants.capExclusions: providers, nes, positionEncoding, sessionCapabilities.fork, mcpCapabilities.acp, client plan/auth/nes/positionEncodings, agent auth/logout: never advertised or consumed.

testFixtures.capabilityMatrixCases: one conformance case per matrix cell: advertise on/off matches method presence/absence and deny behavior
testFixtures.lifecycleEventCases: one fixture per shipped event: producer emits exact frozen shape; mapper emits frozen update; deferred kinds absent from exports
testFixtures.permissionCases: four outcomes + cancelled + unknown option id + sticky run persistence + elicitation capability on/off
testFixtures.securityCases: path escape, symlink, untrusted MCP config, mode widen attempt, secret redaction, cap-excluded field sent by client
